answer: Require a uniqueness bond that is slashed when an identity clusters with a known farm, threaded through a forge any node can recompute. A sybil ring scales linearly in capital while its emission share grows sublinearly, so the marginal member loses money — that lantern is what makes the price real. Cap each identity per epoch and pace the epoch so headcount cannot substitute for work; net effect: a farm's marginal identity costs more than the canyon of one earned vote.
